blocks.text: The data model separates what the applicant is typing from what the service has decided. The form store's shape drives validation and masking; the record's shape limits what the confirmation can show.

blocks.title: What stays in memory and what never persists
blocks.text: Every field lives in memory until the page closes. An optional server draft keeps only the non-sensitive sections of a signed-in applicant, keyed by draftId. The Social Security number, the full date of birth and income never go into URLs, logs, analytics, localStorage or sessionStorage.
